rater_evidence.rater_2: 20-frame full-duration sheet: the two smaller loops are pulled through the central opening of the knot; 'eye' is a standard spatial synonym for that opening and is semantically compatible with the keyed word 'center'.

rater_evidence.rater_2: 20-frame full-duration sheet: after landing the blurred rotor resolves into clearly visible individual blades; the fill 'clear' plausibly describes this same visual transition even though it is less explicit than the keyed phrase.

benchmark_ambiguity.question: [Single-Choice] As the camera pans to the left, what is the apparent motion of the small puff of smoke on the distant hillside relative to the dock's corner post in the foreground? rater_evidence.rater_1: 镜头左移时远处烟雾与近处码头角柱存在明显视差，20 帧中难以支持烟雾始终固定在柱后；模型所述由右向左具有视觉合理性，gold“stationary directly behind”不够稳固。
rater_evidence.rater_2: 20-frame full-duration sheet: throughout the left pan the distant smoke remains aligned behind the dock corner post rather than crossing from one side to the other; the answer mistakes camera motion for relative object motion.

protocol_or_parsing.question: [Fill-in-the-Blank] A third, less illuminated jellyfish starts below the main jellyfish on the left. As the main jellyfish moves down, it briefly occludes the third one. rater_evidence.rater_2: 20-frame full-duration sheet: the dim third jellyfish re-emerges underneath the main bell; the model fill 'bottom' expresses the same below relation as the keyed 'below', so this is not a substantive content error.

protocol_or_parsing.question: [Multiple-Select] Throughout the video, the driver's hands make minor adjustments to the steering wheel. rater_evidence.rater_1: 模型输出 BC 与 gold B,C 是完全相同的选项集合；被计入错误只能由多选格式标准化或解析评分造成。
rater_evidence.rater_2: 20-frame full-duration sheet: the minor steering corrections keep the car centered and negotiate a slight road curve; the response 'BC' exactly matches both keyed options, indicating normalization/parsing rather than content error.

protocol_or_parsing.question: [Single-Choice] During the camera's upward pan, what is the apparent change in the position of the blue star-shaped light in the foreground relative to the red and white star-shaped light behind it? [Options] A) The blue light moves from being below the red light to being above it. B) The blue light appears to move further down and to the left relative to the red light. C) The two lights maintain a fixed spatial relationship to each other in the frame. D) The blue light moves from being to the left of the red light to its right.
protocol_or_parsing.model_answer:
A) The blue light moves from being below the red light to being above it.
C) The two lights maintain a fixed spatial relationship to each other in the frame.

rater_evidence.rater_1: 题目明确为单选，模型同时输出互斥的 A 与 C；其中 C 正是 gold，错误主要由额外输出选项和单选协议未遵守造成，而非完全未识别固定相对关系。
rater_evidence.rater_2: 20-frame full-duration sheet: the blue and red-white star lights keep a fixed relative arrangement through the upward pan, matching C; the model includes C but also emits incompatible option A for a single-choice item.

perception_recognition.question: [Fill-in-the-Blank] Between 0:04 and 0:06, the white paper lantern hanging on the left side of the street is temporarily hidden from view by the corner of the ______ building.

rater_evidence.rater_2: 20-frame full-duration sheet: the covered pier structure crosses in front of the chapel-like building during the right pan while a portion of the chapel remains visible; the negative response misses the partial occlusion sequence.

spatiotemporal_grounding.question: [Fill-in-the-Blank] A utility pole temporarily occludes the man. Immediately after he reappears, he is on the ______ side of the white parked car.

rater_evidence.rater_1: 镜头经过电线杆、男子重新出现时，他位于白色停放车辆的场景左侧；回答给出右侧，混淆遮挡前后位置及画面方向。
